scenarios.title: Unrecognised sign-in
scenarios.description: Review access records for a single staff account.

events.text: Several sign-in requests for the example account were declined.
A new sign-in session was accepted for the same example account.
The account owner reported that they did not recognise this sign-in session.

frames.reason: The available access evidence does not meet a corroboration rule.
frames.analyst: Several sign-in requests for the example account were declined. [E1011]
frames.manager: An account access event needs context.
frames.unknown: The evidence does not establish whether the access was expected.
frames.next_step: Check the identity-provider record and seek independent confirmation.

frames.reason: Rejected requests preceded a new session for this account.
frames.analyst: Several sign-in requests for the example account were declined. [E1011] A new sign-in session was accepted for the same example account. [E1012]
frames.manager: A new session followed several unsuccessful attempts. The owner's involvement needs checking.
frames.unknown: The records do not identify who opened the session.
frames.next_step: Check the session with the account owner through a known contact route.

frames.reason: The identity provider recorded a new session and the account owner independently disputed it.
frames.analyst: A new sign-in session was accepted for the same example account. [E1012] The account owner reported that they did not recognise this sign-in session. [E1013]
frames.manager: Someone may have used the account without the owner's knowledge.
frames.unknown: Who opened the session and what they accessed remain unknown.
frames.next_step: Verify the report with the account owner through a known contact route and refer it to the duty analyst.
